module: Flowgraph node "Activity Reset Prefab" (category once_p_duration, tag activity). Puts the vehicles contained in all prefabs loaded by the associated activity back at their original position, via gameplay_missions_missionManager.resetActivityPrefabVehicles. No custom pins.
notes: Passes self.mgr.activity without checking: without an associated activity, the value is nil.

workOnce.desc: Calls resetActivityPrefabVehicles for the graph's activity.
